_note: Worked example for the Stage 5 rules-file design (see README.md in this folder). Not wired into the app yet — Stage 5 builds the engine that reads files shaped like this.

rules.description: A substituted activity must still map to at least one competency already listed for this topic or sub-topic.
Group size must stay between 2 and 8 learners regardless of the class-size answer given, so it remains a workable group activity.
If the teacher reports no teaching aids are available, only activities tagged for no special aids (or ones on the locked list) may be selected.
A sub-topic marked foundational in the curriculum data can never be skipped, even when the teacher reports high prior mastery for the class.
Preferred activity style (e.g. group work vs individual) may reorder candidate activities but never removes the only activity covering a mandatory competency.
